changes.summary: Bootstrapped AI_AGENT_CORE memory from existing project registration (project_registration).
Fixed One-Click Test scan pipeline: API routing, entity constraints, Kafka blocking. Scan now finds real vulnerabilities (5 findings from 8 scanners).

fixes.root_cause: Controller was at /api/v1/oneclick/scan (no hyphen, different path)
fixes.fix: Added /api/v1/one-click/test (POST) and /api/v1/one-click/{id}/progress (GET) endpoints, changed base path to /api/v1

fixes.root_cause: OneClickService.start() didn't set scanType when creating Scan entity via builder

fixes.issue: Kafka producer blocked 60s per publishEvent call
fixes.root_cause: Kafka broker unreachable from host, producer waits for metadata timeout
fixes.fix: Excluded KafkaAutoConfiguration from @SpringBootApplication, publishEvent checks kafkaTemplate!=null

fixes.issue: Vite proxy pointed to wrong port
fixes.root_cause: Proxy target was port 8081 (docker-compose) but local backend runs on 8080
